resolves: Census Bureau P60 report on 2025 income and poverty, scheduled 2026-09-15 10:00 ET
quantity: Supplemental Poverty Measure poverty rate, calendar year 2025, percent of people
method: Census-published 2024 SPM rate plus PolicyEngine's modeled 2024-to-2025 change. PolicyEngine's simulated levels are held out from calibration and are not comparable to Census levels by construction; only the modeled change is used.

anchor.source: Census SEHSD working paper 2026-17 (2026-08-19), which restates 2019-2024 SPM rates on the corrected BLS thresholds; original P60-287 values listed for reference

model.name: PolicyEngine US canonical SPM runtime (rolling CE and ACS threshold projection, spm-calculator 1.0.0)

runtime.spm-calculator: 1.0.0, wheel sha256 c49c41da5fd482e563eaea956e205a3ba6841cadd4dd32bef4c0c3dbce17ffba (published PyPI wheel e354937a5e1a4045d4966ed594a528d8b02866fabaac9bb5672017004b627305 has byte-identical contents)
runtime.dataset: Microcosm Build P 2024 population with native SPM roles, H5 sha256 6496cc4393d4d3c6574f76eca231de5898c803b9067645591fd5c4d3e65aee84

model.receipt: spm-rebuild-20260908/rollout/final-country-population/FINAL-REPORT.md and final-acceptance/FINAL-ACCEPTANCE-HANDOFF.md (private working directory; hashes in FINAL-INTEGRITY.json)

for_comparison_legacy_production_model.name: policyengine-us 1.764.6 with spm-calculator 0.3.1 (CPI-aged 2025 thresholds), the production model until this rollout

caveats: Runs are development runs on policyengine-core 3.30.1; a rerun on the shipping runtime (core 3.32.5, freshly built dataset) is in progress. If it moves any modeled change by 0.05 pp or more, a dated amendment file will be added; this file will not be edited.
The 18-to-64 group is omitted because its Census 2024 rate was not verified at writing time.
